name: melia
description: A beautiful desktop email client for Linux

scripts.dev: NODE_NO_WARNINGS=1 ELECTRON_DISABLE_SANDBOX=1 node scripts/dev-quiet.mjs electron-forge start
scripts.dev:update: MELIA_DEV_UPDATE=${MELIA_DEV_UPDATE:-1.1.250} MELIA_SPLASH_DEMO_UPDATE=${MELIA_DEV_UPDATE:-1.1.250} NODE_NO_WARNINGS=1 ELECTRON_DISABLE_SANDBOX=1 node scripts/dev-quiet.mjs electron-forge start
scripts.dev:demo: VITE_MELIA_DEMO=1 node scripts/create-demo-db.js && VITE_MELIA_DEMO=1 NODE_NO_WARNINGS=1 ELECTRON_DISABLE_SANDBOX=1 node scripts/dev-quiet.mjs electron-forge start
scripts.dev:stall: MELIA_DEBUG_STALL=${MELIA_DEBUG_STALL:-MOVE:25000} NODE_NO_WARNINGS=1 ELECTRON_DISABLE_SANDBOX=1 node scripts/dev-quiet.mjs electron-forge start
scripts.dev:cred=keyring: MELIA_FORCE_CRED_HEALTH=keyring NODE_NO_WARNINGS=1 ELECTRON_DISABLE_SANDBOX=1 node scripts/dev-quiet.mjs electron-forge start
scripts.dev:cred=degraded: MELIA_FORCE_CRED_HEALTH=degraded NODE_NO_WARNINGS=1 ELECTRON_DISABLE_SANDBOX=1 node scripts/dev-quiet.mjs electron-forge start
scripts.dev:cred=cannot_read: MELIA_FORCE_CRED_HEALTH=cannot_read NODE_NO_WARNINGS=1 ELECTRON_DISABLE_SANDBOX=1 node scripts/dev-quiet.mjs electron-forge start
scripts.dev:cred=cannot_save: MELIA_FORCE_CRED_HEALTH=cannot_save NODE_NO_WARNINGS=1 ELECTRON_DISABLE_SANDBOX=1 node scripts/dev-quiet.mjs electron-forge start
